title: Best Mascara (2026)
summary: A guide to the top drugstore mascaras of 2026.
method: Picks were made by comparing the rankings from The Independent (source 2) and independent.co.uk (source 3), choosing products that appear in both lists and ranking by overall recommendation.
assumptions: Prices are taken from the sources; no discount information was provided.

products.name: CoverGirl Lash Blast Supercloud Mascara
why: The Independent lists it as the best drugstore mascara overall.
Both source 2 and source 3 give it the top spot, indicating strong consensus.
products.desc: A drugstore mascara that promises high volume. It is sold for $13.
products.benefit: Picture a night out when you need dramatic lashes that stand out. The formula builds volume quickly, giving a bold look that outperforms the other picks in sheer fullness. It is the only mascara in this guide labeled as the overall best, so it wins on volume. The catch: it may clump on very fine lashes.
products.skip_if: You have very fine or delicate lashes
products.amazon_listing: CoverGirl Lash Blast Supercloud, 800 Super Black, Mascara, Long-Lasting, No Clump or Smudg

products.name: Maybelline Lash Sensational Sky High Mascara
why: Both sources rank it as the best mascara for shade range.
It offers multiple color options while delivering length and volume.
products.desc: A drugstore mascara with a range of shades that adds length and volume. It is listed at $14 (originally $11).
products.benefit: Picture a daytime office look where you want subtle color variation; the shade options let you match any makeup style. It provides both length and volume, beating the other picks that focus on a single benefit. It is the only mascara highlighted for its shade variety. The catch: the price note shows a higher original price, indicating it may be less budget‑friendly.
products.skip_if: You only need a single classic black shade
products.amazon_listing: Maybelline Lash Sensational Sky High Washable Mascara Makeup, Volumizing, Lengthening, Def

products.name: L'Oreal Paris Telescopic Original Mascara
why: Both sources name it the best lengthening drugstore mascara.
Its brush is designed to stretch lashes for a longer look.
products.desc: A drugstore mascara aimed at lengthening lashes. It is priced at $15 (originally $12).
products.benefit: Picture a photo shoot where you need lashes that look elongated; the telescopic brush pulls lashes out for extra length. It outlasts the other picks in the length category, being the only one singled out for lengthening. The catch: the price is higher than some other drugstore options.

products.name: E.l.f. Cosmetics Lash XTNDR Mascara
why: Both sources list it as the best mascara for separation.
The formula separates lashes without clumping.
products.desc: A drugstore mascara that focuses on separating lashes. It is listed for $8.
products.benefit: Picture a close‑up video call where each lash needs to stay distinct; the XTNDR brush keeps lashes apart for a clean look. It wins the separation category, the only product highlighted for that trait, making it stand out from the volume‑focused picks. The catch: it may not add as much volume as the top overall pick.
products.best_for: Those who need defined, separated lashes

verdict.line: Buy it if you want the most volume from a drugstore tube; it delivers big, bold lashes and is the overall winner in the guide, but the formula can clump on very fine lashes.
also: Maybelline Lash Sensational Sky High Mascara
